description: R statistical modeling with base stats, sandwich, lmtest, car, broom. OLS/WLS/ GLS via lm(), GLMs via glm() (logit, probit, Poisson, negative binomial), robust/clustered SEs via sandwich+lmtest, diagnostics via car, tidy output via broom. Use when execution language is R. Python equivalent: statsmodels. For FE regressions use fixest; for panel RE/between use plm; for complex surveys use survey-r.
